to_markdown_table.note: _rows is two records, the second carrying an extra 'role' key. Columns are the union of keys in first-seen order, so 'id' and 'name' come from the first record and 'role' is appended by the second
to_markdown_table.output:
| id  | name  | role         |
| --- | ----- | ------------ |
| 1   | ada   |              |
| 2   | grace | rear admiral |

to_markdown_table.note: columns= both reorders and drops: 'role' is not rendered
record 1 has no 'role' key, so that cell gets the missing marker
to_markdown_table.output:
| id  | name  | role         |
| --- | ----- | ------------ |
| 1   | ada   | n/a          |
| 2   | grace | rear admiral |

to_markdown_table.note:
pipes are escaped and newlines become
, so one record always stays on one row
no records and no explicit columns means nothing to render
